Create a beautiful Christmas display with this pair of artificial fir trees, bringing you festive light on tabletops, shelves, windowsills, hallway furniture and smaller floor spaces.

Oxo-Biodegradable LZ pattern monofilament netting from the high quality Xnet range of Christmas tree netting by True Products. 
For use in manual or automatic netting machines. 
Used by growers and retailers to wrap trees securely for transportation without damaging tree branches.

To find out what size netting you require, measure the diameter of the small end of your tree netting funnel. 
The netting diameter closest to your measurement will be the one you need.

Sizes available:

LZ55 = 55cm diameter x 400m long sleeve of netting

Colour: White

What is oxo-biodegradable plastic?
Oxo-biodegradable plastic is ordinary plastic to which small amounts of metal salts (a prodegradant additive) has been added during the manufacturing process. The resulting plastic is then made into products like carrier bags, produce or courier bags, straws and other short-life/single-use items. The big difference between oxo-biodegradable and ordinary plastic is that if oxo-biodegradable plastic escapes collection and ends up in the open environment as litter, it will degrade and biodegrade in a similar way to nature’s waste.

How does it work?
In the presence of oxygen, the prodegradant additive breaks the molecular chains in the polymer, and at the end of its useful life the product will degrade and biodegrade, that is it will be consumed by bacteria and fungi, after the additive has reduced the molecular weight to a level which permits them access to the carbon and hydrogen. 

For more detail, please download the document available.

Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Hanging Cord
The hanging cord gives the ornament a defined attachment point for a suitable support. It allows the decorative face to remain visible and makes it easy to include the piece among other hanging accents in the intended display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details

Lightweight and compact design for easy handling and storage.

Versatile decoration suitable for creating a focal point on doors or walls.

5096042276065.variantName: Light-up Christmas wreath - Battery-powered door wreath with 50 warm white LEDs for indoor and outdoor displays - Green, 45 cm
5096042276065.sourceDescription:
A 2.75 m string of 50 warm white LEDs lights this green wreath, with a further 30 cm of lead for positioning the battery box. The outdoor suitability makes it a useful choice for dressing an entrance. It can be used indoors or outdoors, so the same decoration can move between a hallway and an entrance as your plans change. At 45 cm across, it is easy to measure out the space it will occupy before choosing a position.

The lighting gives this wreath two different uses in the same spot. In natural daylight the decorative details provide the colour and texture. Once the lights are switched on, the outline is still visible from the far end of a hall. Warm white light works well alongside wood, brass and cream finishes. If you already have lighting in the same part of the room, see how the two colours look together at dusk before choosing the final position.

Allow access to the battery compartment when arranging the display.

After the festive season, lay the decoration in a box with space around its edges. Keep heavy ornaments and tightly coiled strings of lights separate so that the front of the wreath keeps its shape in storage. On a mantel wall, the wreath can sit above the display while the shelf below stays clear for cards and small ornaments. Leave a little space between the top of the cards and the bottom of the wreath so their outlines remain distinct.

For a calm scheme, carry one colour from the decoration into a nearby ornament and leave the space immediately around the wreath clear. The display then has a daytime focal point as well as an illuminated outline in the evening. If you plan to use the wreath in a group, set it out with your other decorations before you hang them. A little breathing room around its edge usually shows the shapes more clearly than placing several pieces edge to edge.
Illuminate your entrance with 50 warm white LEDs powered by batteries for easy indoor or outdoor placement.
Compact 45 cm diameter design fits standard doorways and walls, providing a festive focal point without overwhelming the space.
Versatile decoration suitable for both indoor hallways and outdoor displays, allowing flexible seasonal positioning.
Features a 2.75 m light string with an additional 30 cm lead wire to conveniently position the battery box out of sight.
Comes with None

Bring traditional festive greenery to your decorating scheme with the GloBrite 2.7m Green Pine Christmas Garland. Designed with realistic cedar-style foliage and PVC tips, the flexible garland can be shaped around fireplaces, staircases, banisters, doorways and seasonal displays. Its plain green finish provides a versatile base for traditional, rustic or contemporary Christmas decorating, while adjustable branches allow the foliage to be arranged to suit your space. Suitable for indoor and outdoor decorative use, the 2.7m length offers generous coverage for larger areas. Simply unwrap, fluff and position the branches before styling. Other GloBrite 2.7m options include Snowtip and No LED variations.
2.7m festive coverage – Provides generous length for styling fireplaces, staircases, banisters, doorways and larger Christmas displays.
Flexible construction – Adjustable branches can be shaped, curved and arranged around different surfaces for easier seasonal decorating.
Realistic pine styling – Cedar-style green foliage and PVC tips create a traditional evergreen-inspired appearance.
Plain green design – Provides a versatile backdrop for ribbons, baubles, bows and other decorative themes already in your collection.
Indoor and outdoor use – Suitable for creating coordinated Christmas displays across different decorating areas.
Easy seasonal setup – Unwrap, fluff and position the branches to achieve the desired shape, then wipe clean before storage when required.
Suitable for Indoor & outdoor use
Included: 2.7m Green Pine Christmas Garland with 40 LED Lights

5056589110765.sourceDescription:
Bring classic holiday charm into your home with this beautifully crafted Snow Tipped Christmas Garland. Thoughtfully designed to capture the timeless beauty of the festive season. Whether you're decorating for a traditional Christmas gathering, a winter-themed party, or a cosy festive setting, this green Christmas garland will become a focal point of any seasonal display.

Measuring 270cm in length, this garland provides ample of room to hang any additional decorations such as lights and baubles. At 25cm wide, it provides a substantial yet manageable size, offering a balance of fullness without overwhelming your space. Featuring a blend of pinecones, mixed needles, and snow tipped branches for a subtle wintry touch. With 214 PVC tips, this garland offers a full, realistic appearance. Crafted from high-quality PVC to maintain their form and colour year after year.

Please note; the branches of the garland will need to be arranged and fluffed to achieve a full and bushy appearance just like the product images. 

Suitable for indoor and sheltered outdoor use.

Product Specifications.
Length: 270cm 25cm Wide
Snow-Tipped Detailing: Lightly frosted branch tips give this garland a gentle, snow-kissed effect—perfect for achieving a cosy, wintry look without heavy flocking.
Mixed Needle Texture: Crafted with a variety of needle styles, this garland offers depth and realism that mimics natural evergreen branches, enhancing its lifelike appearance.
Decorative Pinecones: Natural-style pinecones are thoughtfully placed throughout the garland, adding a rustic, woodland feel to your holiday decor.
Full & Lush Design: With 214 high-quality PVC tips, this garland is thick and voluminous, ensuring a full-bodied look that makes an elegant statement wherever it’s placed.
Generous 270cm Length: Spanning 2.7m, this garland offers ample coverage for decorating larger areas such as mantels, stair railings, door frames, and windows, creating a festive look throughout your space.
Manufacturer guarantee: 1 year
Suitable for Indoor use

5059442021765.sourceDescription:
Picea glauca Conica is a highly popular, upright-growing, evergreen conifer with symmetrical foliage. The tree presents dense, true-green foliage that turns blue-green over time and produces a strong, fresh, pine scent. The Conica is a perfect feature for any room in the house and once the festive season is over, is a wonderful addition to any garden.
FESTIVE, INDOORS OR OUTDOORS: Picea Glauca Conica is a dwarf variety of conifer with dense, upright foliage. This tree can be decorated and kept inside throughout the festive season, before being planted outside, or can be planted outside straight away.
GREAT SHAPE & FRAGRANCE - The Conica produces very symmetrical, true-green foliage, that turns to blue-green as it matures. The needles are densely packed, short and have a fresh pine scent. Perfect as a seasonal decoration around your home.
LOW MAINTENANCE: These trees are very easy to care for. With minimal watering and some sun, this tree can live for 20+ years.
PLEASE NOTE: Images are for illustrative purposes only. This plant will be supplied in a growers pot. The total height listed is inclusive of the pot.
